## Checklist — the things that matter most here

- [ ] **Dignity:** any user-facing wording is respectful and warm — no pity, no condescension.
- [ ] **Privacy:** no precise location is exposed; coarsening is intact; no collector tracking; no
      analytics that phone home. (See docs/en/04-privacy-and-dignity.md)
- [ ] **No keys/secrets:** nothing secret is committed; the default homing mode still works with **no keys**.
- [ ] **Honesty:** I did not describe the PWA as doing screen-off/background voice (it doesn't).
- [ ] **Accessibility:** giant text, high contrast, big touch targets, one-button flow and voice-first
      behaviour are preserved. (See docs/en/05-accessibility.md)
- [ ] **Safety:** guidance stays advisory; nothing directs a user into danger.
- [ ] **Spec/docs:** if behaviour changed, I updated the design spec and relevant docs first.
- [ ] **Tests/CI:** I added/updated tests where sensible, and CI passes.
- [ ] I agree my code is licensed **Apache-2.0** and my docs **CC BY 4.0**.
